subject.title: Generated Skill Card missing after successful publish and rescan

question: What does the production `skillCardGenerationJobs` state show for tasktimepro/tasktime-agent version 1.0.7: no job, a terminal failure, or an undispatched queued job?
rationale: That operator-only evidence determines whether this needs a one-off requeue, worker/dispatch repair, or a source-level enqueue fix; repository source alone cannot safely distinguish them.

options.title: Inspect and repair the job
options.body: Query the exact production version and card job, requeue it through the supported internal path, and open a focused source fix only if the state exposes a repeatable lifecycle gap.

options.title: Start a source repair now
options.body: Patch the lifecycle without production job evidence, accepting a significant risk of fixing the wrong transition.

recommendation.title: Inspect and repair the job
recommendation.body: Query the exact production version and card job, requeue it through the supported internal path, and open a focused source fix only if the state exposes a repeatable lifecycle gap.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and most recently changed the current Skill Card queue and scanner integration.
